stem:
Tejas leaves a metal spoon in hot soup. The spoon handle grows warm though he is not heating the handle directly. He also stands near a glowing room heater without touching it and feels warmth on his face.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Heat reaches the spoon handle mainly by conduction through the metal.
Heat reaches his face from the heater mainly by radiation.
Heat reaches his face from the heater only by conduction through solid metal parts he is not touching.
The spoon handle warms only by radiation; metal never conducts heat.

teacher.key_rationale: Heat travels along the metal spoon by conduction. Warmth from the heater to his face without contact is mainly radiation.
